subject: Hanuman Chalisa
prompt: The Hanuman Chalisa takes its name from a word meaning which number?
why: It is forty chaupais in praise of Hanuman, written by Tulsidas in Awadhi and the best-known passage of the Ramcharitmanas.

subject: PlayStation 4
prompt: Sony launched the PlayStation 4 in North America in November 2013. When did it reach Japan?
why: Japan got it last, in February 2014, after North America, Europe, South America and Australia -- an unusual order for a Japanese company's flagship console.

subject: The Apothecary Diaries
prompt: The Apothecary Diaries began in 2011 on what kind of platform?
why: It was serialised on Shosetsuka ni Naro, where anyone can post fiction. A publisher picked it up in 2012 and the light novels, manga and anime followed.

subject: Miss Universe 2023
prompt: Sheynnis Palacios won Miss Universe 2023, delivering a first-ever crown for which country?
why: It was Nicaragua's first win in the pageant and its first victory in any of the Big Four international pageants. The final was held in San Salvador.

subject: Google Scholar
prompt: In which year did Google Scholar launch in beta?
why: It indexes peer-reviewed journals, books, conference papers, theses and preprints, and has been free to use since that November beta.

subject: Brazil national football team
prompt: What is the nickname of the Brazil national football team?
why: Canarinho means 'little canary', for the yellow shirt. The others belong to Argentina, Colombia and Chile.

subject: Translation
prompt: English separates translating from interpreting. What does interpreting cover?
why: Translating handles written text; interpreting handles spoken or signed communication. Many languages draw no such distinction and use one word for both.
